subject: Streaming probe: test account + allowlist + k6 scenarios
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@heliodata.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Streaming probe: test account + allowlist + k6 scenarios

Hi Samir — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we can kick off the customer-led probe: 

Goals we heard from you
- P95 latency target: <= 200ms for non-generated control tokens; 95th p95 for end-to-end streaming under production-like payloads.
- Sustained concurrency: 400–600 concurrent streaming sessions (we should plan for 500 as the target).
- Throughput proxy: ~1.8k Req/s equivalent across multiplexed streams (we'll translate to k6 VUs).
- Token-rate expectations: approx 35–45 tokens/sec per active stream for your typical chat workloads.

What we need from HelioData to start
1) IP ranges to allowlist for your test orchestrator + any SRE jump boxes (please include CIDR).
2) Preferred 4-hour windows for a dry-run and a full run (our suggestion below).
3) Names/emails for any external testers who need test credentials or access to the SRE Slack channel.
4) Any special traffic patterns (burst ratio, ramp-up shape, or long-tail sessions).

Redwood deliverables (what we'll provide)
- k6 scenarios and a Locust translation sketch (attached: k6-streaming-scenarios.js).
- Dedicated test account with scoped rate limits and a short-lived API key (we'll drop creds into a secure file).
- Probe runbook and monitoring links; we'll instrument token-level latency and per-connection metrics.
- A short canary (10–15 min) followed by the main 4-hour sustained window; rollback/fallback plan included.

Suggested windows (PST)
- Dry run: Tue 2027-06-01 02:00–06:00 UTC (evening for you, early morning for us)
- Full run: Wed 2027-06-02 01:00–05:00 UTC

Attachments: k6-streaming-scenarios.js (script), probe-runbook.pdf (run checklist)

Open questions / decisions
- Do you want us to run the k6 orchestrator from Redwood-managed infra or from Helio's orchestrator? (If Helio runs it, we'll need the exact IPs and an SSH bastion account.)
- Any tokens/data sensitivity constraints for the payloads (PII)? We can synthesize payloads.

Next step: if the windows work, Samir, can you share the SRE contact and the CIDR blocks? Once we have that Marissa will create the test account and I’ll upload the scripts.

Thanks —
Connor O'Brien
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
connor@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Samir Patel <samir@heliodata.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
Cc: HelioData SRE <sre@heliodata.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Streaming probe: test account + allowlist + k6 scenarios

Connor — thanks for the clear recap. Confirming a few items: 

- HelioData target: p95 <= 200ms is correct for our interactive flows; we also want visibility at p99 for CPU-backed tails.
- Preferred full-run window: Wed 2027-06-02 01:00–05:00 UTC works for us. Dry-run on 2027-06-01 is fine as well.

IP allowlist (egress from our orchestrator)
- 35.214.10.0/24
- 34.120.5.128/26
- 10.240.0.0/16 (internal SRE jump hosts)

SRE contact for test coordination:
- Sarah Lind (sarah.lind@heliodata.com) — she’ll be on the call and can provide bastion creds.

We prefer Helio to run the k6 orchestrator (we want to validate from our network). We’ll provide a bastion host IP and a small jump account; Redwood can provide the test API key and k6 scripts.

Payload: use synthetic user IDs only, no customer PII. If Redwood needs sample payloads we’ll share a sanitized set.

I’ll loop in Sarah on this thread.

—Samir
Samir Patel
Head of Platform | HelioData
samir@heliodata.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@heliodata.com>, HelioData SRE <sre@heliodata.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Streaming probe: test account + allowlist + k6 scenarios

Thanks Samir / Connor — copying Lauren for ops. Connor I’ll create the dedicated test account and generate a scoped API key that expires in 7 days. Action items I’ll take: 

- Create test account: will create username `helio-probe-connor` and post creds to the secure vault; I’ll attach a short creds stub to the thread once done (redwood-test-account-creds.txt).
- Upload k6 script to the shared drive and validate environment variables (we’ll substitute the API key and stream endpoints).
- Add the three CIDR ranges to our allowlist; if Helio adds extra dynamic IPs later, ask them to notify us 24h before the run.
- Create a lightweight Grafana dashboard for the probe (token latency, connections, token/s, backpressure events).

Notes / clarifications:
- Because Helio will run k6 from your orchestrator, please ensure that your bastion can reach the test endpoint on 443 and allow websocket upgrades.
- We'll provide a short smoke checklist for your SRE to run before the dry-run — checking TLS, DNS, and API key access.

Attaching: probe-runbook.pdf (checklist) and a pointer to k6 script in Drive.

Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai

Samir / Sarah — perfect, thanks for the quick turn. Summary and next steps from Redwood: 

1) We’ll add allowlist for the three CIDR blocks Samir provided. Marissa will post the test API key to the vault by EOD Monday.
2) Helio will run k6 from your orchestrator via bastion; Sarah, please reply with the SSH jump username and the bastion public IP when convenient.
3) I uploaded the initial k6 scenarios to Drive and attached the runbook PDF to this thread (probe-runbook.pdf). Link: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cREDWOOD-probe-runbook
4) Dry run: 2027-06-01 as discussed. Full run: 2027-06-02 01:00–05:00 UTC. We’ll schedule a post-run sync immediately after the full run to review p95/p99 and error modes.

For the post-run sync I’ll invite product and infra (Lauren will join and take point on charts).

If anything changes on Helio's side (extra IPs, different ramp shape), please send a quick update with 24h notice.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Connor
